reason: 18 fully registered tools have implemented handlers, but advertised sandbox/health guarantees exceed implementation and preview bypasses the default write gate.
exposure: 11 tools exposed by default; 7 tools in WRITE_TOOLS hidden and calls refused unless GTM_GA4_MCP_WRITE=true. All 18 included here. GA4 tools remain exposed even without GA4_PROPERTY_ID.
limitations: Literal tool registration extracted offline without loading server or contacting Google; no tools/list runtime or API functionality verification performed.

Workspace resolution uses GTM_SANDBOX_WORKSPACE_ID directly or selects Default Workspace; there is no separate sandbox-name validation or SafetyError check claimed by README (src/index.ts lines 318-335).
gtm_preview calls quick_preview while omitted from WRITE_TOOLS, so available in default read-only exposure; handler returns API payload rather than a constructed Preview URL.
gtm_get_client_context returns healthy without verifying connectivity and reports auto-detect rather than actual resolved workspace ID.
GTM tag/trigger/variable lists and consent audit do not follow nextPageToken; advertised all-tag audits may be partial. Consent audit measures status heuristically, not actual consent integration.
GA4_PROPERTY_ID is optional at startup, but all GA4 handlers construct properties/ even when absent.
Input JSON bodies are strings by upstream schema; no nested GTM body schema, enums, or defaults are registered. Described/handler defaults are deliberately not invented as schema defaults.
Backlog gtm_list_versions is proposed, not registered or implemented, and excluded from tool catalog.

tools.name: gtm_get_client_context
tools.description: Health check and status overview. Returns GTM container path, workspace ID, GA4 property ID, and server version. Use this to verify connectivity.
tools.behavior: Returns configured paths and version with a hard-coded healthy status; does not contact Google or resolve the actual workspace.

tools.name: gtm_list_tags
tools.description: List all tags in the sandbox GTM workspace with name, type, consent status, and firing triggers.
tools.behavior: Lists the first API page of workspace tags and returns IDs, types, consent status, pause state and firing triggers.

tools.name: gtm_get_tag
tools.description: Get full details of a single tag by ID from the sandbox workspace.
tools.behavior: Gets one tag from the resolved workspace.

tools.name: gtm_update_tag
tools.description: Update a tag in the sandbox workspace. Fetches current tag, merges updates, then saves. Safety: only operates on sandbox workspace.

updates_json.description: JSON object with fields to update (e.g. consentSettings, parameter)

tools.behavior: Reads the tag, parses updates_json, shallow-merges fields, and updates with its current fingerprint.

tools.name: gtm_create_tag
tools.description: Create a new tag in the sandbox workspace. Safety: only operates on sandbox workspace.
tools.behavior: Parses tag_json and creates a tag in the resolved workspace.

tools.name: gtm_list_triggers
tools.description: List all triggers in the sandbox GTM workspace.
tools.behavior: Lists the first API page of workspace triggers as IDs, names and types.

tools.name: gtm_list_variables
tools.description: List all variables in the sandbox GTM workspace.
tools.behavior: Lists the first API page of workspace variables as IDs, names and types.

tools.name: gtm_get_variable
tools.description: Get full details of a single variable by ID from the sandbox workspace.
tools.behavior: Gets one variable from the resolved workspace.

tools.name: gtm_create_variable
tools.description: Create a new variable in the sandbox workspace. Safety: only operates on sandbox workspace.

variable_json.description: Full GTM variable JSON (must include name, type, and type-appropriate parameter array)

tools.behavior: Parses variable_json and creates a variable in the resolved workspace.

tools.name: gtm_update_variable
tools.description: Update a variable in the sandbox workspace. Fetches current variable, merges updates, then saves. Safety: only operates on sandbox workspace.

updates_json.description: JSON object with fields to update (e.g. parameter, name)

tools.behavior: Reads the variable, parses updates_json, shallow-merges fields, and updates with its current fingerprint.

tools.name: gtm_delete_variable
tools.description: Delete a variable from the sandbox workspace. Destructive. Safety: only operates on sandbox workspace.
tools.behavior: Deletes one variable in the resolved workspace.

tools.name: gtm_audit_consent
tools.description: Scan all tags in the sandbox workspace and report consent compliance. Returns tags with no consent, NOT_NEEDED tags, properly configured tags, and recommendations.
tools.behavior: Fetches tags twice and classifies first-page consent status with tag-type/name-based recommendations; does not validate consent wiring.

tools.name: gtm_preview
tools.description: Generate a GTM Preview URL for the sandbox workspace.
tools.behavior: Calls workspace quick_preview and returns its API response without constructing a preview URL.

tools.name: gtm_create_version
tools.description: Create a version (snapshot) of the sandbox workspace. Does NOT publish.
tools.behavior: Creates a container version from the resolved workspace and returns its ID, name and path without publishing.

tools.name: gtm_ga4_run_report
tools.description: Query GA4 historical report for the property linked to this GTM container.
tools.behavior: GA4: runs a historical report using configured property ID, comma-separated fields and optional equality filter; handler defaults eventName/eventCount, 7daysAgo/today and 100 rows.

tools.name: gtm_ga4_realtime_report
tools.description: Query GA4 Realtime Report (last 30 minutes) for the property linked to this GTM container.
tools.behavior: GA4: runs a realtime report using configured property ID, comma-separated fields and optional equality filter; defaults eventName/eventCount.

tools.name: gtm_ga4_list_custom_dimensions
tools.description: List all registered custom dimensions for the GA4 property linked to this GTM container.
tools.behavior: GA4: lists registered custom dimensions using the Analytics Admin client.

tools.name: gtm_ga4_create_custom_dimension
tools.description: Register a new custom dimension in the GA4 property linked to this GTM container.
tools.behavior: GA4: creates a custom dimension; maps scope USER to USER and every other value to EVENT.

review.summary: Inspect tag consent settings, preview workspace compilation, and create or update draft tracking resources.
